landing.heroDesc: A system for the farmers' association to manage machinery services and financial information — including service booking and scheduling, financial monitoring, farmer income and expense tracking, and expense forecasts for the next season.
landing.aboutBody: CalFFA is the Farmers' Association Management System of the Calapan Federation of Farmers Association. It helps the association manage machinery services and financial information in one place — from service requests and scheduling to financial records, farmer income and expenses, and seasonal expense forecasts.
landing.featuresIntro: The system focuses on four core capabilities that support day-to-day association work.
landing.feature1Desc: Allows farmers to submit machinery service requests while authorized users can review, approve, schedule, and track machinery service transactions.
landing.feature2Desc: Records member contributions, machinery service income, and operational expenses and generates financial summaries.
landing.feature3Desc: Allows farmers to record and monitor individual income and production-related expenses.
landing.feature4Desc: Uses available historical data to forecast farmers' expenses for the next season and provide insights for financial planning.
landing.helpsBody: The system helps organize machinery service requests, monitor association finances, track farmers' financial information, and provide expense forecasts for planning.
landing.ctaBody: Authorized members and officers can sign in from the button above to manage machinery services and financial information.

legal.title: Terms & Data Privacy
legal.summary: Tap "Show details" to read membership terms and RA 10173 data privacy before you register.
terms: By registering, you apply for CalFFA (Calapan Federation of Farmers Association) cooperative membership.
Your account starts as Pending until your Barangay President reviews and approves your application.
You must provide accurate personal, contact, and farm information. False or misleading details may lead to rejection or removal.
Approved members may use CalFFA services (machinery booking, loans, share capital, announcements, and related programs) according to cooperative policies.
CalFFA officers may update membership status, roles, and access based on barangay records and federation rules.
legal.privacyLead: CalFFA collects and processes your data only for legitimate cooperative purposes:
privacy: Data collected: full name, reference number, birth date, address, phone number, educational status, barangay, farm area/location, account credentials, and (for Google sign-up) email and profile photo.
Purpose: member registration, identity verification, barangay assignment, approval workflow, service delivery, and compliance with cooperative records.
Access: authorized CalFFA administrators and barangay officers (e.g., President, Treasurer) for your assigned barangay; shared only when required by law or with your consent.
Security: passwords are stored using secure hashing; access is limited to authorized system users.
Rights: you may request correction of your records through your barangay officer or CalFFA administration, subject to verification.
Retention: records are kept while membership is active and as required by cooperative and applicable legal requirements.
legal.agreeLabel: I agree to the terms and conditions and data privacy policy, and consent to CalFFA processing my personal data as described above.
